### 会话收起 / Hide conversations

- **#59：再次点击当前会话，即可收起右侧聊天内容，显示欢迎页；再点即可重新打开。** 单聊、讨论组均支持，聊天记录和会话列表保留，启动时仍默认不展开聊天。
- 收起或切换会话时，各会话的文字、引用、@ 和待发送附件草稿暂存在当前进程中，重新打开后恢复；退出应用后不保留这些草稿。
- 隐藏期间的新消息保留未读，远端「抖一抖」和重新聚焦窗口不会自动展开聊天；主动点击通知、搜索结果或通讯录仍正常打开。
- **#59: Click the active conversation again to hide its contents and show the welcome page; click once more to reopen it.** Works for direct chats and groups, keeps conversation history and list entries, and preserves the blank startup view.
- Text, replies, mentions, and pending attachments are kept separately for each conversation while hidden or switched away. Drafts remain in memory for the current app session only.
- Incoming messages remain unread while hidden. Remote nudges and window refocus do not reopen the conversation; explicit notification, search, and contact navigation still open it normally.

### 验证 / Validation

- Linux 环境：135 个测试文件、986 项测试通过；Electron ABI 110 数据库自测、双端类型检查、生产构建、启动冒烟、版本及双语文档检查通过。
- 实际 Electron 22.3.27 / Xvfb：通过生产界面和鼠标/键盘输入验证单聊、群聊收起与恢复、启动空白页、文字及图片附件草稿恢复、不同会话草稿隔离、隐藏时未读保留、抖一抖及窗口恢复不展开、通知点击恢复，以及深浅色主题。后端会话数据使用隔离测试夹具，网络仅绑定本机回环地址。
- Local Linux checks passed: 986 tests across 135 files, the Electron ABI 110 database self-test, both type checks, production build, startup smoke, version consistency, and documentation locale checks.
- Actual Electron 22.3.27 under Xvfb exercised the production UI with mouse/keyboard input: direct/group chat toggling, blank startup, text and image draft restoration, draft isolation, unread preservation, hidden-state nudges and window refocus, explicit notification navigation, and light/dark themes. Backend conversation data used isolated fixtures with loopback-only networking.
